nodes.description: Private mapping(bytes32=>RoleData) storing role members and admin roles in AccessControl.
Public constant bytes32 DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (0x00), the default admin role for all roles.
Private string revert message used by the only() modifier for insufficient permissions.
Boolean initialization guard, set to true by the initializer modifier.
Public constant bytes32 MANAGER_ROLE = keccak256("MANAGER_ROLE") used to gate predicate functions.
Public constant bytes32 event signature hash expected as topic0 of the exit log.
External initializer that sets contract id and grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MANAGER_ROLE to _owner.
Manager-only function that parses an RLP exit log, validates signature/withdrawer and calls setData on rootToken.
Manager-only lockTokens override that immediately reverts with 'Disabled feature'.
Public view returning whether an account holds a role by querying _roles members set.
Public function granting a role; requires caller to hold the role's admin role.
Public function revoking a role; requires caller to hold the role's admin role.
Public function letting an account renounce its own role; requires account == _msgSender().
Internal unchecked role grant used during initialization.
Internal function that writes the admin role for a given role in _roles.
Private function adding a member to a role set and emitting RoleGranted.
Private function removing a member from a role set and emitting RoleRevoked.
Internal function building the _revertMsg string from a contract id.
Modifier requiring hasRole(role, _msgSender()) before executing the guarded function.
Internal view returning msg.sender as the execution sender.
Internal view using extcodehash to determine whether an address is a contract.
Internal function sending ETH via low-level recipient.call{value:amount}("").
Private function performing an arbitrary low-level target.call{value:weiValue}(data) with revert bubbling.
Modifier that requires !inited and flips inited to true to prevent re-initialization.
Internal pure conversion of bytes into an RLPItem using inline assembly for the memory pointer.
Internal pure conversion of an RLP list item into an array of RLPItems.
Internal pure conversion of an RLP item into a uint256 using assembly shift.
Internal pure conversion of an RLP item payload into a bytes array.
Internal wrapper that delegates to _functionCallWithValue with zero value.
msg.sender returned by Context._msgSender, attacker-influenced caller address.
msg.sender consumed by the only() modifier through _msgSender() for role checks.
msg.sender compared against account in renounceRole.
Low-level recipient.call{value: amount}("") in Address.sendValue forwarding full gas to an arbitrary address.
Low-level target.call{value: weiValue}(data) in Address._functionCallWithValue executing arbitrary calldata.
External call Data(rootToken).setData(data) in exitTokens where rootToken is externally supplied.
Owner address parameter of initialize receiving both admin and manager roles.
Withdrawer address parameter validated against the log topic1 in exitTokens.
Root token address parameter used as the target of the external setData call.
Raw RLP-encoded exit log bytes parameter of exitTokens.
Role identifier parameter of grantRole.
Account parameter of grantRole receiving the role.
Decoded RLP list of the exit log top-level items.
Decoded RLP list of the log topics extracted from logRLPList[1].
ABI-decoded bytes payload passed to Data(rootToken).setData.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by Context._msgSender as the caller identity.
The only() modifier uses _msgSender() inside hasRole to authorize the caller.
renounceRole authorizes by comparing account with _msgSender().
Caller-controlled msg.sender is the subject of the role check in only().
exitTokens is gated by only(MANAGER_ROLE).
lockTokens is gated by only(MANAGER_ROLE).
MANAGER_ROLE constant is the role argument passed to only(MANAGER_ROLE).
initialize grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to _owner.
initialize calls _setupRole to assign DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MANAGER_ROLE.
initialize calls _setupContractId to set the revert message.
initialize is protected by the initializer modifier against repeated calls.
_setupRole delegates to _grantRole without permission checks.
grantRole calls _grantRole after checking the admin role.
revokeRole calls _revokeRole after checking the admin role.
_grantRole adds the account to _roles[role].members.
_revokeRole removes the account from _roles[role].members.
_setRoleAdmin writes _roles[role].adminRole.
hasRole reads the members set from _roles[role].
_setupContractId writes the _revertMsg state variable.
The only() modifier reads _revertMsg as the require error message.
The initializer modifier sets inited to true.
CUSTOM_EVENT_SIG is compared against topic0 inside exitTokens.
withdrawer parameter is validated against log topic1 in exitTokens.
The log parameter is decoded into logRLPList via toRlpItem().toList().
logRLPList[1] is decoded into the logTopicRLPList topics array.
toRlpItem is used on the log bytes in exitTokens.
toList is used to decode the log and topics in exitTokens.
toUint is used on the topics to recover the event signature and sender.
toBytes is used on logRLPList[2] to extract the payload.
The decoded data local variable is forwarded as calldata to Data(rootToken).setData.
The rootToken parameter becomes the target contract of the external setData call.
exitTokens executes the external Data(rootToken).setData(data) call.
Data(rootToken).setData transfers control to an externally supplied contract that can call back into exitTokens before completion.
sendValue performs the low-level value transfer to recipient.
recipient.call{value: amount}("") forwards all gas and can reenter the calling contract.
_functionCallWithValue performs the low-level call to target with arbitrary data.
target.call{value: weiValue}(data) lets the callee reenter the calling contract.
isContract(target) is required before the low-level call in _functionCallWithValue.
functionCall delegates to _functionCallWithValue with value 0.
The _owner parameter of initialize is granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MANAGER_ROLE.
The role parameter is used to resolve the role's admin and to grant the role.
The account parameter is the recipient of the granted role.

normalization_plan.reason: The _owner parameter is only meaningful inside initialize where roles are granted to it.
The withdrawer parameter is consumed only by the validation logic of exitTokens.
The rootToken parameter directly determines the target of the unsafe external setData call.
The log parameter is decoded and validated only within exitTokens.
The role parameter is used only to resolve the admin role and grant within grantRole.
The account parameter is the grantee handled entirely within grantRole.
logRLPList is a temporary decoded value local to exitTokens.
logTopicRLPList is a temporary decoded topics array local to exitTokens.
The data local variable is the calldata supplied to the unsafe Data(rootToken).setData call.
